name: TweenAnimationBuilder
desc: Animates related properties through the Tween, and performs partial builds through the builder to reduce the refresh scope. No need for custom animators, you can specify animation duration, curve, and end callback.

fields.name: tween
fields.desc: Defines the target value for the animation.

fields.name: builder
fields.desc: Called every time the animation value changes.

fields.name: child
fields.desc: The child widget to pass to the builder.
